ns2:course.label: Case Stud Agr Accy & Fin Plan
ns2:course.description: Capstone course for agricultural accounting, agricultural finance, and financial planning; applies business and planning concepts and tools to real-world situations; emphasizes group decision making; industry professions participate in the learning experience.
